channel.description: Latest articles from The Albert Lea Tribune (albertleatribune.com)

item.title: Editorial: Sales tax would expand regional opportunities
item.description: The Albert Lea City Council on Monday voted to bring the renewal of the half-cent local option sales tax to the Legislature.

item.title: Gov. Tim Walz orders weapons screening at Minnesota Capitol ahead of upcoming session
item.description: Gov. Tim Walz issued an executive order Monday requiring weapons and hazardous materials screening at the Minnesota Capitol for the 2026 legislative session.

item.title: DEED awards $6M in contamination cleanup and investigation funding, including for project in Albert Lea
item.description: The Minnesota Department of Employment and Economic Development (DEED) on Tuesday announced more than $6 million for 13 communities to assess and clean up contaminated sites for redevelopment.

item.title: Gaming strategies for roulette and blackjack: which ones work in the long run
item.description: But, roulette and blackjack draw gamers for diverse reasons.

item.title: Which Team Will Bring the Next Major Men’s Championship to Minnesota?
item.description: Even the most partisan Minnesotan would have to admit that the North Star State has not been over-endowed with sports championships.

item.title: Albert Lea player reaches 1,000 career points in big win over Winona
item.description: Albert Lea High School senior Carter Conn reached a major career milestone Tuesday night, scoring his 1,000th career point in a standout performance against Winona.

item.title: Immigration enforcement in rural Minnesota spreads fear, strains local leaders
item.description: Many immigration enforcement actions are flying under the radar in greater Minnesota because of fewer observers to document them. The operations are also creating problems for local city leaders and law enforcement agencies, while stirring fear and anxiety in many residents across the state.

item.title: Hundreds gather to honor Alex Pretti at Minneapolis vigil
item.description: A crowd gathered Wednesday night at 26th Street and Nicollet Avenue in Minneapolis, near where Alex Pretti, 37, was killed by federal agents last weekend.

item.title: Albert Lea FFA wins Region 7 Agriculture Mechanics Contest, advances to state
item.description: The Albert Lea FFA agriculture mechanics team earned a first-place finish out of 14 teams at the Region 7 FFA Agriculture Mechanics Contest held Monday.

item.title: 7 Ways to Earn Passive Income with Crypto (Even During a Bear Market)
item.description: Bear markets today can make earning extra income feel like a slow grind.
